answers.core: It pertains to every person using the script editor in Godot who would like better readability of line wrapping. It's a very general and fundamental use case.
answers.workaround: This is a very fundamental feature, and my guess is that it would be used often. I'm not sure how easy it is in script to do this.

title: Have further soft-wrapped lines be darkened to distinguish the same line in the script editor
